subject.title: fix: A2A handoffs can duplicate message-tool replies

question: Should OpenClaw accept this waited A2A artifact-suppression boundary for message-tool mirror and inter-session transcript rows before merge?
rationale: The patch is focused and well covered, but it intentionally changes message-delivery eligibility for A2A announce paths, and green CI cannot fully prove every real channel transcript shape.

options.title: Accept Boundary
options.body: Proceed after exact-head checks because the fix is narrow and the added Gateway/QA proof targets the duplicate visible-message failure mode.

options.title: Request Live Channel Proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted live WhatsApp or equivalent channel transcript if maintainer confidence requires production-channel evidence beyond the deterministic QA harness.

options.title: Defer To Broader A2A Work
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want the reverse-send and compaction-related duplicate fixes resolved under one coordinated A2A delivery decision.

recommendation.title: Accept Boundary
recommendation.body: Proceed after exact-head checks because the fix is narrow and the added Gateway/QA proof targets the duplicate visible-message failure mode.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent delivery-mirror transcript provenance work makes Vincent the closest adjacent owner for deciding whether this artifact boundary is the right one.
